the oscillations of neutrinos at high energy or density can be described by the standard formulae of the MSW theory, with the matter-induced potential V replaced with the quantity V_{\mathrm{eff}} = V - 2 \sin^2 \theta_{12} V_0, where V_0 is the potential due to the solar neutrino conversion and \theta_{12}, \theta_{13} are the mixing angles in vacuum.
